turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR across all campaigns in September 2026?
turns.answer: Total ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026 was 6,270.00 EUR (covering 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
